value.text: Diagnosis on main (daemon 26fc3ba for canaries A-B, 077d383 telegram-only rebuild for C): both defects reproduced live with three Codex 0.164 canaries; causes named with file:line and captured input; plan 177 had no effect. Bind: pij has no registration path for a spawned Codex seat (not new: same spawn.failed 2026-09-08). Identity: Codex >=0.157 hosts TUI threads in a shared app-server daemon carrying its first launcher's PIJ_SESSION_ID/TMUX_PANE (ps eww; canary B probe). assets/evidence/diagnosis.md, assets/evidence/canaries/.

Red on 26fc3ba: a scratch worktree at 26fc3ba plus only the new tests/fixtures; 10 tests fail for the diagnosed reasons (warning line read as footer; spawn argv lacks daemon_auto_start; send accepted as pij-parallel-bandicoot; whoami answers bandicoot; not-registered refusal advises pij adopt; timeout names nothing; wrapper rejects --harness). assets/evidence/receipts/red-on-26fc3ba.txt.
Green on the branch: the same tests pass (harnesses 15, daemon 12, cli 1). assets/evidence/receipts/green-on-branch.txt.

Mutation receipts: 15 fixes reverted one at a time (footer, spawn argv, wrapper pane setting, binder parent/pane/trigger/revived checks, identity recorded-thread/probe checks, send/adopt/whoami call sites, timeout reason, header-less update prompt, bind-loop wiring); every one turned its test red; files restored (git status clean). assets/evidence/receipts/mutations.txt.

Registration: spawn passes features.daemon_auto_start=false and check_for_update_on_startup=false (canaries D, E: no update menu, in-process); the daemon Codex binder binds a pending spawned row from the wrapper's child holding a thread-writer lock, verified against tmux and the process table (codex_bind_tests: binds; nothing outside the pane or the wrapper's child binds; revived seat keeps its conversation; the bind loop runs it). A Codex spawn timeout names the screen (tests::codex_spawn_timeout_names_the_prompt_on_screen, codex::tests). assets/evidence/after-ruling.md.

Identity: per-thread shell_environment_policy.set of PIJ_SESSION_ID/PIJ_SPAWN_ID/TMUX_PANE (canary C proved it beats the inherited daemon env; spawn tests, cli spawn_child test). A caller carrying CODEX_THREAD_ID must be the seat its thread runs in, else E-RS-CODEX-IDENTITY with exact text and no adopt advice (codex_caller_tests: send/whoami refused, inherited pane neither advised nor adoptable and nothing minted, recorded-thread mismatch refused, own pane passes, non-Codex unchanged).

Footer: parse_codex_footer requires a two-word <model> <effort> head; fixtures 2026-10-26 pane %53 (daemon-hosted, quota warning + warnings hint) and 2026-10-28 pane %113 (in-process, title + warning hint) pin model, cwd, readiness and composer recognition; a warning-only frame is not ready.

Docs: docs/how/pij-rs-api.md 'Codex seats (plan 181)' (identity, spawn settings, binder and its cost, named spawn errors, E-RS-CODEX-IDENTITY); docs/how/pij-pane-signals.md Codex section (two-word head, warning and hint lines). skills/pij read for contradictions: ready.md's Codex self-adopt still holds for an in-process seat and already says conflicting evidence refuses; nothing contrary.

Cost (R12): launch-counting tests on the injected facts port: no pending row = 0 launches over 10 ticks; an unbindable pending row = 1 launch at first sight, 0 over 50 quiet ticks, 1 more per Codex thread start; a bind = 3 launches (codex_bind_tests). Live baseline before merge: spawns counter absent on this base (lands with #73); #73's spawn-rate.py 20 s: daemon children 70.3/s with 5 pending spawned Codex rows and no binder. The after reading is the prime's post-deploy. assets/evidence/receipts/r12-spawn-rate-baseline.txt.
